name: ЛНК: проверки (Node.js, Python, Chromium)
postCreateCommand: npm install -g playwright && sudo env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers "$(npm prefix -g)/bin/playwright" install --with-deps chromium && sudo sh -c 'f=$(find /opt/pw-browsers -type f -name chrome -perm -u+x | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && ln -sfn "$f" /opt/pw-browsers/chromium' && sudo apt-get install -y unzip fonts-liberation && (python3 -m pip install openpyxl python-docx pymupdf || python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages openpyxl python-docx pymupdf || python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages openpyxl python-docx pymupdf)
